title: Experts disagree on VoyageEmbeddingProvider
context:
Chief architect: Keeping the change inside one class is what keeps this a small change, as the owner chose with option A. The error mapping is already required by the accepted EX-security-auditor-2 and EX-integration-architect-1. The other claim names a 'network' error code that does not exist: the real codes are missing_api_key, invalid_api_key, rate_limited and provider_error.

Target: VoyageEmbeddingProvider
- application-architect: the fetch call to the Voyage embeddings endpoint stays inside VoyageEmbeddingProvider in src/rag/providers.ts behind the existing VoyageEmbeddingClient interface in src/rag/types.ts, so createEmbeddingProvider and every caller stay unchanged
- application-architect: non-2xx responses from the Voyage endpoint map to the same providerError codes the SDK path produced (missing_api_key, invalid key on 401, rate limit, network), so the provider error contract and its tests keep their shape
